reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 1540 for the 8855-receiver graph (K(23,4) per binomial_match). Lower bound: independent set of 1540 (check passed). Upper bound: linear code M = I + 4A over F_5 of length 1540, with code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all true. One code tried. Agent wall time 35.7 s (llm 26.3 s, compute 9.4 s) vs kushagra_agent 41.6 s with the same exact result; slightly faster, same accuracy. CP-SAT alpha/cover timed out (~156 s), frac_cover gave only 8855 unproven, f2_minrank_sat found nothing. LLM time dominates the agent's wall time. Nothing suspicious, though own_rank is unavailable at N = 8855 (> 2500).
